title_text: Who's Afraid of the Octopus Man?
credits_text: CHRISTIAN VAN CITTERZ, JUSTIN LAMASSU, AUDREY NEUMANN, COURTNEY PORTER, SETH ROTH, KYLE SCOTT, BEN SOTTER
description: A dark, eerie poster features a shadowy figure with tentacle-like appendages against a forest backdrop, evoking a sense of psychological horror and mystery.
